# Third-party notices

This hxn-gpu package contains the project's Haxe sources. Native GPU drivers
and the hxnsl compiler are distributed in their own haxelibs, with their
own dependency licenses and notices. This package embeds neither their
native binaries nor their Rust dependencies.

Applications redistributing those binaries must retain the applicable
`third-party/` notices shipped with hxn, hxnsl and each selected GPU driver.
The hxn-gpu sources are covered by the project's top-level LICENSE.
